senses.zh_definition: 汤普金斯：英语来源的姓氏，属 Tompkins 的拼写变体；具体人物的中文译名以既有译法为准。
senses.en_definition: Thompkins, an English-origin surname that is a variant of Tompkins.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga yang berasal daripada bahasa Inggeris dan merupakan variasi ejaan Tompkins; takrif ini ialah huraian editorial, bukan petikan definisi DBP.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，正文应写 Thompkins。输入未提供 DBP 释义；不能据此认定它是马来语普通词，也不能擅自改写为 Tompkins 或 Thompson。status 按要求保留为 official，不表示已取得 DBP 收录认证。以下搭配为说明性姓名使用框架，未宣称其语料频率。姓氏关系依据《Dictionary of American Family Names》：[Thompkins 条目](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/thompkins)。

etymology.historical_story: The Dictionary of American Family Names identifies Thompkins as a variant of Tompkins, and explains Tompkins as a patronymic from Tomkin, a medieval familiar form of Thomas. This connects the surname with historical naming practices based on a parent's name. It does not establish any particular bearer's ancestry, and the inherited spelling remains important for identifying individuals. [Thompkins](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/thompkins)；[Tompkins](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/tompkins)。
